semantic_filtered.text: At the conclusion of this project phase, the core outputs discussed in section “Key Outputs for the Assessment and Design Phase” will be delivered via a comprehensive workshop with the senior management team. This workshop will drive a retrospective on current data maturity, alongside a comprehensive plan towards data-driven decision making.

Resources:

Full time analytics consultant, data engineer

Engagement Manager & Principal oversight

This practical assessment of systems, data, and mapping artifacts will ensure that efforts to resolve mapping and broader system unification are targeted and effective, while directly supporting mappings for a subset of entities to inform possible automation solutions.

Requirements from Harbor Team

During Week 0:

Harbor IT to provide access to key source systems & datasets. This access is to allow JMAN to assess the underlying data quality and complexity of the build.

We anticipate 2 x 1 hour ‘Systems & Data Access Preparatory sessions’ will be required to understand & successfully access the most important source datasets to inform the design and discovery phase.

During Phase 1

These requirements will be refined and agreed based on the pre-kick off sessions, but please find an indicative summary of time requirements from Harbor during Phase 1 below.

1-2 days of workshops with management to understand the business model, define value levers and equity story

1-2 days of workshops with specific end-users across the business units to understand existing pain-points and reporting opportunities (Week 1 & 2)

3-4 meetings with internal data owners across source systems to understand existing data flow

Daily 30 min meetings with project sponsor and technical owners to test material & for general support unblocking any challenges faced

1-hour weekly Steerco update to ensure discovery and recommendations are aligned with the group

An available contact for core business systems to address any clarification questions
